Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with relative lymphopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Glucose is slightly low. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Findings may suggest acute or chronic hypoxic state, possible infection or inflammation, and bone marrow suppression or stress response. Clinical correlation is recommended.
